THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
STREET & CITY
179
STUDY 084
Gray Pleated Skirt & Charm Bag Street
Rights check
Source: 24966.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, dark wavy hair
stands on a cobblestone street outside a café with
flower boxes. She wears a gray cardigan with a white
collar and a pale gray bow at the neck, with a black
pleated mini skirt and tall black platform knee-high
boots. A black shoulder bag carries three plush bear
charms. Gold drop earrings and a gold necklace. Her
expression is warm, with a soft smile. Bright, warm
daylight, a palette of charcoal, white, and black. Playful
and polished, in the style of a European street-style
photo.
Playful, cute, polished
WORKING NOTES
- The plush bear charms and bow collar are the playful
details.
- Keep the café and cobblestones for a Parisian street
setting.
